name: file-signature
description: A signed document or signature field.
useCase: Identify a file containing a signature or an action to sign a document.
misuse: Do not use the handwritten mark alone as proof that a signature is valid.

16.reason: An open handwritten stroke keeps its rises distinct without a return loop and stays at least 1px clear of the page border.

24.reason: The handwriting uses longer independent curves with open valleys instead of a doubled loop; its lower and right edges clear the page by at least 1.5px.
